description: Job Description: Production Engineer – CT/PT Transformer Industry Job Title: Production Engineer Industry: CT/PT Instrument Transformer Manufacturing Department: Production Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering Experience: 0–10 Years Job Location: Tushar Trans Equipment Pvt Ltd Employment Type: Full-Time Job Summary We are looking for Production Engineers to manage and monitor the manufacturing processes of Current Transformers (CTs) and Potential Transformers (PTs). Candidates should have a basic understanding of production activities, good coordination skills, and knowledge of basic ERP data entry. Freshers and experienced candidates with Electrical or Mechanical Engineering qualifications are welcome to apply. Key Responsibilities Monitor daily production activities according to the production plan and schedule. Coordinate CT/PT manufacturing processes, including winding, core assembly, insulation, assembly, and other activities as applicable. Ensure timely completion of production orders and achievement of production targets. Maintain daily production reports, job cards, work orders, and manufacturing records. Perform basic ERP entries related to production orders, material consumption, production output, and job status. Coordinate with the stores department for raw material availability and material issuance. Work closely with the quality and testing departments to resolve production-related issues. Monitor material utilization, production rejection, and wastage. Ensure proper utilization of manpower, machinery, tools, and equipment. Identify production delays and take necessary corrective actions in coordination with the concerned departments. Maintain proper documentation and ensure adherence to company procedures. Follow workplace safety rules, 5S practices, and quality standards. Coordinate with planning, purchase, stores, testing, quality, and dispatch departments. Educational Qualifications B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Diploma in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering. Required Skills Basic knowledge of CT/PT transformer manufacturing processes. Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel and MS Office. Basic knowledge of ERP software and data entry. Ability to maintain production records and prepare daily reports. Good communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of manufacturing processes, material management, and production planning is an advantage. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Achievement of daily and monthly production targets. Timely completion of manufacturing orders. Accuracy of ERP entries and production documentation. Reduction in material wastage and production rejection. Efficient utilization of manpower and materials. Compliance with quality, safety, and manufacturing standards.

ai_summary.why: Candidate has strong backend and distributed systems experience with Kafka, PostgreSQL, and AWS, aligning with the production engineer's need for data management and ERP skills.
ai_summary.gaps: Lacks specific knowledge of CT/PT transformer manufacturing processes and basic electrical engineering fundamentals required for this role.

description: Job Title: Testing Engineer Industry: Electrical Manufacturing – CT/PT Transformers Qualification: Diploma / BE in Electrical Engineering Experience: 0–10 Years Job Location: Tushar Trans Equipment Pvt Ltd (POR GIDC) Department:Testing Job Summary We are looking for a motivated and technically skilled Testing Engineer to perform routine, type, and other applicable electrical tests on Current Transformers (CT) and Potential/Voltage Transformers (PT/VT). The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, accuracy, reliability, and compliance with applicable IS/IEC standards and customer specifications. Key Responsibilities Perform routine testing of CT and PT/VT transformers as per approved test procedures. Conduct tests such as: Insulation Resistance (IR) Test Winding Resistance Test Ratio Test Polarity Test Accuracy Test Excitation / Knee Point Test, wherever applicable Burden and Phase Angle Error Test Power Frequency Withstand / High Voltage (HV) Test Partial Discharge Test, wherever applicable Operate and maintain electrical testing equipment and instruments. Verify test results against approved drawings, specifications, and applicable IS/IEC standards. Prepare and maintain test reports, inspection records, and quality documentation. Identify testing failures, investigate root causes, and coordinate corrective actions. Coordinate with Production, Quality Assurance, and Design departments to resolve technical issues. Ensure compliance with safety procedures during testing activities. Support calibration and maintenance of testing equipment. Educational Qualification Diploma in Electrical Engineering, or BE / B.Tech in Electrical Engineering. Required Skills Knowledge of Current Transformers (CT) and Potential/Voltage Transformers (PT/VT). Understanding of electrical measurements and transformer testing procedures. Familiarity with applicable IS/IEC standards, drawings, and technical specifications. Ability to analyze test results and prepare accurate test reports. Good troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. Knowledge of electrical safety practices.

description: Job Requirements We are seeking a passionate and motivated DevOps Engineer with exposure to AI and Cloud Technologies to join our growing team. This role is ideal for professionals with 1+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) who are looking to expand their expertise in AI infrastructure, automation, and cloud-native technologies. The successful candidate will build agentic AI solutions on Azure that boost efficiency for our team and for the development teams using our cloud infrastructure and deployment tools. You'll embed AI agents into our cloud runtime and CI/CD pipelines, with governance and human-in-the-loop oversight, to automate routine tasks and speed up provisioning and deployments. Key Responsibilities Agentic Engineering Identify AI use cases that boost efficiency and let us scale to more teams and partners without proportional effort. Pinpoint manual work that grows with every new team or partner, such as onboarding, provisioning, and support requests. Design and build AI agents for the selected use cases, from prototype to production. Embed agents into CI/CD pipelines, provisioning workflows, and the cloud runtime. Operate, monitor, and maintain agents in production. Enforce governance, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop approval for agent actions. Measure efficiency and scalability gains, and continuously improve agent quality, reliability, and cost. Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Operations Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure on Azure or AWS. Operate Kubernetes and container platforms for application and AI workloads. Automate infrastructure provisioning with Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Build and maintain Helm charts for application deployments. Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, and deployment issues. DevOps & Automation Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar tools. Automate operational tasks with PowerShell and C#. Drive release management, deployment automation, and environment provisioning. Use AI-powered tools to increase operational efficiency. AI & MLOps Support Deploy and monitor AI/ML applications and services. Maintain MLOps workflows with Azure ML, MLflow, or Kubeflow. Monitor performance of AI workloads and their infrastructure. Monitoring & Reliability Implement monitoring and alerting with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or cloud-native tools. Resolve incidents, run root cause analyses, and optimize performance. Improve system reliability, scalability, and availability. Required Technical Skills Agentic Engineering Hands-on experience building AI agents with LLMs Familiarity with agent frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or LangChain Experience integrating agents with tools, APIs, and knowledge sources (e.g., MCP, RAG) Understanding of AI governance, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns Ability to evaluate and monitor agents for quality, reliability, and cost Ability to identify use cases where AI improves efficiency and scalability Exposure to Azure ML, Kubeflow, or MLflow. Understanding of AI-assisted operations (AIOps). Cloud Platforms Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform: Microsoft Azure (preferred), AWS or GCP. Containers & Orchestration Docker Kubernetes (basic to intermediate) Helm, including building reusable charts for teams to use Infrastructure as Code Terraform and/or ARM Templates / Bicep, including building reusable modules Ansible (basic knowledge) Programming & Scripting Python, PowerShell, Bash, C# Experience automating workflows and building developer tools CI/CD & Version Control Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions Git-based workflows Monitoring & Logging Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Azure Monitor or similar tools Operating systems Linux Windows Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field. 1+ years in DevOps, Cloud/Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, or SRE. Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Solid understanding of CI/CD and deployment automation. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code. Basic knowledge of AI/ML deployment and MLOps. Experience building and running AI agents or LLM-based solutions, ideally on Azure. Track record of identifying AI use cases that improve efficiency and scalability. Understanding of responsible AI, governance, and human-in-the-loop practices. Knowledge of cloud security and networking basics. Experience working in Agile teams. Azure, Azure AI, AWS, Kubernetes, or Terraform certifications are a plus. Nice-to-Have Skills Knowledge of GitOps practices. Experience with container security and vulnerability management. Familiarity with distributed systems and microservices architectures. description: Arm’s Physical IP Division develops Physical IP that is extensively used by SoC designers around the world to build sophisticated, high-performance chips on groundbreaking process nodes. We are looking for a Graduate Software Engineer to join the Design Enablement team within Solutions Engineering - Implementation organization. You will build and maintain software tools and automated EDA flows used to develop, validate, and deliver custom cells and custom macros. Working alongside experienced software engineers and circuit designers across Arm's global engineering sites, you will learn established development practices while contributing practical solutions for engineering teams. Responsibilities Develop and sustain software applications and automated workflows that support custom cells and custom macro development and validation. Write clear, maintainable code in Java or Python, with supporting automation in Tcl, Bash, or tcsh. Work with circuit designers and software engineers to understand requirements and implement practical solutions. Help integrate new build methodologies and EDA tools into Custom Cells workflows. Support efficient, scalable, and parallel execution of EDA workloads in on-premises and cloud environments. Write unit, integration, and regression tests, investigate failures, and debug software issues. Participate in code reviews, document changes, and provide support to engineering users. Essential Skills and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Science, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related technical field. Good programming skills in Java, Python, or both, including object-oriented programming and data structures. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with attention to software quality and accuracy. Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively. Familiarity with software development fundamentals, including version control and automated testing. “Desired” Skills and Experience: Experience or coursework in Tcl and Unix shell scripting, including Bash or tcsh. Familiarity with Linux or Unix development environments. Basic understanding of digital electronics, semiconductor design flows, or Physical IP. Exposure to EDA tools or batch-computing and job-scheduling environments such as IBM Platform LSF. In Return: At Arm, we believe in nurturing talent and providing opportunities for growth. You will join a team that embraces inclusion and collaboration, working on ambitious projects that push the boundaries of technology. We offer a dynamic work environment where your contributions are recognized and rewarded. Join us and be a part of a world-class team that is dedicated to delivering flawless solutions that compete at the highest level! Our 10x Mindset At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x-mindset Use of AI in Your Application At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you. Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. Hybrid Working Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. Equal Opportunities Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

description: **About Us** Valiance is a global AI & Data analytics firm helping clients build cutting-edge technology solutions for digital transformation. We work with some of the marquee brands across India, US and APAC to build transformative solutions for Credit Risk, Fraud, Predictive Maintenance, Quality Inspection, Data lake, IOT analytics etc. Our team comprises 120+ professionals across Machine Learning, Data Engineering & Cloud expertise. As a Generative AI Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and implementing cutting-edge generative AI models to solve complex problems. You will work closely with various stakeholders to design, build, and deploy AI-powered solutions that enhance ABG products and services. **Key Roles and Responsibilities** 1. Define, build and deploy enterprise focused Generative AI solutions on Microsoft Azure cloud services. 2. Comfortable working in the cloud and high-performance computing environments -Azure/ GCP. 3. Utilize off-the-shelf Azure (OpenAI) services, to integrate LLM capabilities into applications, and collaborate with the business and IT teams. 4. Create, Modify and deploying code libraries, accelerators (GitHub) programming languages such as Python, R. 5. Build Rapid prototypes and do proof of concepts (PoC) in one or all the following areas: LLM, NLP, DL (Deep Learning), ML (Machine Learning), object detection / classification, tracking, etc. 6. Apply prompt-engineering techniques to specific use cases and types of models. 7. Stay informed about the latest advancements in Gen AI, machine learning, and AI technologies to optimize our technical stack. 8. Co-ordinate for Tech Support and Continuous improvements **Skills required** 1. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in generative AI and experience working with LLM (Large Language Models) in particular. 2. 2-3yrs experience with AI technology and Azure cloud services, Cognitive services (AI, ML, LLM, algorithm), Python, NLP, Generative AI. 3. Strong understanding of Open AI (Chat GPT, GPT, Chatbot) 4. Better understanding on fine-tuning with Azure OpenAI distributed OpenAI models such as DaVinci, curie, Babbage, ADA. 5. You are proficient in Python and have experience with various machine learning libraries and frameworks with necessary Azure cloud experience of configurations, troubleshooting etc. 6. Good communication skills and basic customer mgmt.

description: Sansera Engineering is an engineering-led integrated manufacturer of forged complex and high-precision components for the automotive, non-Automotive and Aerospace sectors. With a rich legacy spanning over three decades, Sansera Engineering is committed to delivering quality products to its global clientele. As we continue to expand our operations and workforce, As we continue to expand our operations and workforce, we are seeking talented and dedicated individuals to join our team. JOB TITLE: Engineer – Process Design Department: Process Design Experience: 1–3Years PRIME FUNCTION To prepare and maintain process engineering documents that support effective process planning, risk assessment, quality control, and standardization of manufacturing processes. Job Description / Responsibilities Prepare, review, and update Machining Drawings (MD), Process Drawings (PD), Control Plans (CP), and Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA). Interpret customer drawings, GD&T requirements, engineering specifications, and dimensional tolerances to define manufacturing process requirements. Develop process sequences and identify critical dimensions, process parameters, and inspection requirements. Identify potential process failure modes, assess risks, and coordinate actions to prevent defects. Ensure consistency between machining drawings, process drawings, PFMEA, and control plans. Coordinate with Production, Quality, Design, and Tool Engineering teams during process development and implementation. Update process documents following engineering changes, manufacturing trials, and improvement activities. Maintain document revision control and ensure approved documents are available at the point of use. Support process trials, troubleshooting, and audits related to process documentation. AUTHORITY Recommend changes to process drawings, manufacturing sequences, and process controls. Raise technical concerns regarding drawing requirements, dimensional tolerances, and manufacturing feasibility. Initiate document revisions and coordinate approvals as per established procedures. COMPETENCY Qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. Technical Competencies: Understanding of GD&T, engineering drawings, and dimensional tolerances. Knowledge of machining processes and manufacturing process planning. Ability to prepare and maintain MD, PD, CP, and PFMEA. Working knowledge of AutoCAD or relevant engineering drawing software. Understanding of process risk assessment, quality controls, and document revision management. Behavioural Competencies: Analytical thinking and attention to detail. Problem-solving and continuous improvement. Effective communication and cross-functional coordination. PERFORMANCE MEASURES Timely preparation and release of process documents. Accuracy and completeness of drawings and documentation. Consistency between PFMEA, control plans, and process drawings. Timely implementation of engineering changes and risk mitigation actions. Reduction in documentation errors and related audit observations.

ai_summary.why: Strong backend experience with Kafka, PostgreSQL, and AWS aligns well with process design requirements for manufacturing systems.
ai_summary.gaps: Lacks direct mechanical engineering background and CAD experience required for process design.
